references.text: The Lord warns that he will send the sword against Israel and hand them over to their enemies as punishment for breaking the covenant.
The anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he let them wander in the wilderness for forty years.
God warns that his wrath will flare up against the people and that he will abandon them and hand them over to their enemy.
Israel could not stand against the enemy because the Lord had handed them over.
Israel could not withstand the enemy because they were under a curse for having sinned against the Lord.
The anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim.
The Lord sold Israel into the hands of Jabin, king of Canaan, who oppressed them.
The anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines and the Ammonites.
Israel forgot the Lord their God, and he sold them into the hands of Sisera, the Philistines, and the king of Moab.
The anger of the Lord burned against his people, and he handed them over to the nations so that their enemies ruled over them.
Israel was sold because of their sins and wicked deeds.
